summary.what_it_does: The page describes Earkick as a tool for tracking and improving mental health, with an AI chatbot character (a panda) for self-care. It says the tool proactively identifies mental health risks and provides actionable recommendations. Its meta description also mentions a tool for measuring workplace mental health in real time. The page text provided is mainly a blog disclaimer stating that content is informational only and not a substitute for professional therapy or medical treatment, so few concrete features are confirmed here.
notable: Proactive mental health risk identification and recommendations
Workplace mental health measurement in real time (per meta description)
caveats: Not a substitute for professional therapy or medical treatment, per the page disclaimer
